import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MOD2 = 1007681537;
    static final int INF = (int)1e9;
    static final long LINF = (long)1e18;
    static final double PI = Math.acos(-1.0);
    static final double EPS = 1e-9;

    static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            long t = a % b;
            a = b;
            b = t;
        }
        return a;
    }

    static long lcm(long a, long b) {
        return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
    }

    static int fpow(long n, long k, int p) {
        long r = 1;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) r = (r * n) % p;
            n = (n * n) % p;
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return (int)r;
    }

    static int chkmin(int[] a, int val) {
        if (val < a[0]) {
            a[0] = val;
            return 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int chkmax(int[] a, int val) {
        if (a[0] < val) {
            a[0] = val;
            return 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static long isqrt(long k) {
        long r = (long)Math.sqrt(k) + 1;
        while (r * r > k) r--;
        return r;
    }

    static long icbrt(long k) {
        long r = (long)Math.cbrt(k) + 1;
        while (r * r * r > k) r--;
        return r;
    }

    static int addmod(int a, int val, int p) {
        a += val;
        if (a >= p) a -= p;
        return a;
    }

    static int submod(int a, int val, int p) {
        a -= val;
        if (a < 0) a += p;
        return a;
    }

    static int mult(int a, int b, int p) {
        return (int)((long)a * b % p);
    }

    static int inv(int a, int p) {
        return fpow(a, p - 2, p);
    }

    static int sign(double x) {
        return (x > EPS) ? 1 : (x < -EPS) ? -1 : 0;
    }

    static void transform(int[] a, int n, int p, int invert) {
        int k = 0;
        while ((1 << k) < n) ++k;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            int step = 1 << i;
            for (int msk = 0; msk < n; ++msk) {
                if ((msk & step) != 0) {
                    int pmsk = msk ^ step;
                    if (invert == 0) {
                        a[msk] = (a[msk] + a[pmsk]) % p;
                    } else {
                        a[msk] = (a[msk] - a[pmsk] + p) % p;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] pow_convol(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        int n = a.length;
        if (k == 1) return a.clone();
        if ((k & 1) == 1) {
            int[] r = pow_convol(a, k - 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (r[i] == 0) continue;
                for (int j = 0; j < n - i; ++j) {
                    res[i + j] = (int)((res[i + j] + (long)r[i] * a[j]) % p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        } else {
            int[] r = pow_convol(a, k >> 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (r[i] == 0) continue;
                for (int j = 0; j < n - i; ++j) {
                    res[i + j] = (int)((res[i + j] + (long)r[i] * r[j]) % p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static int[] subset_pow_convol(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        final int logn = 19;
        int n = a.length;
        int m = 1;
        while (m < n) m <<= 1;
        n = m;
        int[][] fa = new int[logn][n];
        int[][] fc = new int[logn][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < logn; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                    fa[i][j] = (j < a.length) ? a[j] : 0;
                } else {
                    fa[i][j] = 0;
                }
                fc[i][j] = 0;
            }
            transform(fa[i], n, p, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            int[] va = new int[logn];
            for (int j = 0; j < logn; ++j) {
                va[j] = fa[j][i];
            }
            int[] vb = pow_convol(va, k, p);
            for (int j = 0; j < logn; ++j) {
                fc[j][i] = vb[j];
            }
        }
        int[] res = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < logn; ++i) {
            transform(fc[i], n, p, 1);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                    res[j] = fc[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static final int maxn = 1000005;
    static int[] fac = new int[maxn];
    static int[] ifac = new int[maxn];
    static int[] f = new int[maxn];

    static void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int nn = n;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            if ((n & i) == i) {
                int t = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < 20; ++j) {
                    if (((n >> j) & 1) != 0) {
                        t = (t << 1) | ((i >> j) & 1);
                    }
                }
                f[t] = i;
                nn = t;
            }
        }
        if ((n & 1) != 0) {
            System.out.println(fpow(k, n, p));
            return;
        }
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < maxn; ++i) fac[i] = mult(fac[i - 1], i, p);
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; ++i) ifac[i] = inv(fac[i], p);
        int[] a = new int[nn + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= nn; ++i) a[i] = ifac[f[i]];
        int res = fpow(k, n, p);
        a = subset_pow_convol(a, k, p);
        res = submod(res, mult(a[nn], fac[n], p), p);
        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
}
